Detailed Description

Provides all available methods for the IListener interface.

Set of methods that allows a developer to manage and take actions within different phases of App ad display.

Note:
For additional information on how to use Flurry's Ads SDK to attract high-quality users and monetize your user base see Support Center - AppCircle.

void onAdClosed ( String  adSpace)

Invoked when the ad has been removed.

Since:
3.0.0

This method informs the app that an ad has closed. You can use this to resume app states.

Parameters:
adSpaceThe placement of an ad in your app, where placement may be splash screen for SPLASH_AD.
void onApplicationExit ( String  adSpace)

Invoked when the ad has been selected that will take the user out of the app.

Since:
3.0.0

This method informs the app that an ad has been clicked and the user is about to be taken outside the app.

Parameters:
adSpaceThe placement of an ad in your app, where placement may be splash screen for SPLASH_AD.
void onRenderFailed ( String  adSpace)

Invoked when an ad fails to render.

Since:
3.0.0

This method informs the user an ad was retrieved, however, was unsuccessful in displaying to the user (could be lost network connectivity for example).

Parameters:
adSpaceThe placement of an ad in your app, where placement may be splash screen for SPLASH_AD.

Map< String, String >  rewards 
)

Invoked when a user completes an action locally that results in a revenue bearing transaction.

Since:
3.0.0

This method informs the user has completed a revenue bearing action.

Note:
This is only called for local methods (like video views) and is not called on the completion of an app install/launch.
Parameters:
adSpaceThe placement of an ad in your app, where placement may be splash screen for SPLASH_AD.
rewardsPasses additional information that can be used to identify the user.
boolean shouldDisplayAd ( String  adSpace,
FlurryAdType  type 
)

Invoked when an ad will display on the specified adSpace.

Since:
3.0.0

This method informs the app that an ad will display to the user. You can use this to pause app states. You can also decide not to show this ad by simply returning false.

See also:
FlurryAgent.showAdForSpace for details on the method that will invoke this delegate.
Parameters:
adSpaceThe placement of an ad in your app, where placement may be splash screen for SPLASH_AD.
typeThe type of ad to be displayed. See FlurryAdType for allowable values.
